question: What all-pervading range should be contemplated in each place during meditation?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in place after place.
The object of meditation extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
This range defines the scope of contemplation.
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality extending from Śiva down to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated in each and every place on that which extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
